evals.name: rule5-tiebreaker
evals.prompt: capture: home renovation project needs a contractor meeting on Thursday at 2pm
evals.expected_output: Classifies as schedule-item via Rule 5 tie-breaker (both time anchor AND project ref present). Appends [[home-renovation-project]] to the item. Writes to `Eliot/Schedules/Daily/<Thursday>.md` (root-prefixed — never a bare `Schedules/Daily/...`). Confirms with ≤2 sentences naming the full Eliot/-prefixed path.

assertions.name: project-wikilink-appended
assertions.description: Response mentions [[home-renovation-project]] or equivalent project wikilink
assertions.check: response.txt contains '[[' and 'renovation' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: classified-as-schedule-item
assertions.description: Classifies as schedule-item, not task or project-update
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt mentions 'schedule' as the type; does NOT say 'task' or 'project-update' as the classification result

assertions.name: targets-thursday-daily-note
assertions.description: Target path is a daily note for Thursday under the Eliot/ root, not Projects/ or Notes/, and not a bare Schedules/Daily/ without the Eliot/ prefix
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt shows a path under Eliot/Schedules/Daily/ targeting Thursday; FAILS if the path shown is bare 'Schedules/Daily/...' without the 'Eliot/' prefix

assertions.name: confirmation-is-short
assertions.description: Confirmation is ≤ 2 sentences (voice rule)
assertions.check: response.txt contains ≤ 2 sentences of confirmation after the action

assertions.name: self-names-as-eliot
assertions.description: Response contains the word 'Eliot' (self-identification, Metric 5a)
assertions.check: response.txt contains 'Eliot' (case-sensitive)

assertions.name: wikilink-only-when-project-verified
assertions.description: The [[wikilink]] is written only after the project is confirmed to exist (obsidian search/read hit in Projects/). If no matching project file exists, Eliot must offer to create it or capture without a link — never silently write a dangling wikilink
assertions.check: trace.txt shows a Projects/-scoped search or read for the project BEFORE the write; if no match was found, response.txt contains an offer to create the project instead of a silent [[...]] write

evals.name: daily-review
evals.prompt: eliot, what's on my plate today?
evals.expected_output: Triggers daily review flow. Makes ≤3 CLI calls. Returns structured response with today's date, schedule, due-today, active projects. ≤10 lines. Eliot voice: no exclamation marks.

assertions.name: attempts-explicit-schedule-read
assertions.description: Attempts obsidian read path="Eliot/Schedules/Daily/<today>.md" (CLI call #1, explicit root-prefixed path) — the plugin-coupled 'tasks daily todo' subcommand is no longer used (§A3 decoupling)
assertions.check: trace.txt mentions 'read' and ('Eliot/Schedules/Daily' or 'schedules_daily'); FAILS if the only call shown is 'tasks daily todo'

assertions.name: attempts-due-today-search
assertions.description: Attempts obsidian search with #due/<today> (CLI call #2)
assertions.check: trace.txt mentions 'search' and '#due/' or 'due'

assertions.name: structured-multi-section-response
assertions.description: Response has ≥ 2 distinct sections (schedule, tasks, projects, or equivalent)
assertions.check: response.txt contains at least 2 section headers or labelled groups

assertions.name: no-exclamation-marks
assertions.description: Response contains no exclamation marks (voice rule)
assertions.check: response.txt does not contain '!'

assertions.name: graceful-cli-error-handling
assertions.description: If CLI errors occur, response does not crash or bypass vault — surfaces error cleanly
assertions.check: response.txt does not contain raw stack traces or attempt direct filesystem reads

evals.name: note-capture
evals.prompt: capture: I think the reason our standups always run over is because we don't timebox individual updates — people drift into problem-solving mode instead of just stating status
evals.expected_output: Rule 4 fires (≥20 words + 'I think') → note → `Eliot/Notes/<YYYY>/<slug>.md` (root-prefixed — never a bare `Notes/...`). No clarifying questions. Confirmation ≤2 sentences naming the exact root-prefixed file.

assertions.name: classified-as-note
assertions.description: Classifies as note (not task or inbox)
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt says classification is 'note', not 'task', 'inbox', or 'schedule-item'

assertions.name: targets-notes-folder
assertions.description: Target path is under Eliot/Notes/ (not bare Notes/, and not Schedules/ or Projects/ or Inbox/)
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt shows path under 'Eliot/Notes/'; FAILS if the path shown is bare 'Notes/...' without the 'Eliot/' prefix

assertions.name: meaningful-slug
assertions.description: Filename/slug is derived from content (not generic like 'note1' or 'capture')
assertions.check: response.txt or trace.txt shows a filename containing words related to 'standup', 'timebox', or 'meeting'

assertions.name: confirmation-names-exact-file
assertions.description: Confirmation ≤ 2 sentences and names the exact file path
assertions.check: response.txt contains a file path in the confirmation and is ≤ 2 sentences

assertions.name: no-unnecessary-clarification
assertions.description: Does not ask clarifying questions (input is unambiguous for Rule 4 — has a 'because' clause, passes the substance gate)
assertions.check: response.txt does not contain a question mark as a clarification request

assertions.name: lean-note-no-empty-sections
assertions.description: Created note omits empty optional sections: no empty '## Why It Matters' heading, no '## Connections' with the bare '- Supports: / - Challenges:' skeleton (§Template Enforcement section policy)
assertions.check: the created note content in trace.txt does NOT contain '- Supports: ' with empty value and does NOT contain a '## Why It Matters' heading with no body; frontmatter has 'type: permanent' and a 12-digit 'id'

evals.name: plugin-escape-schedule-capture
evals.expected_output: Rule 1 fires → schedule-item. Even when the vault's Daily Notes plugin is configured to a folder outside Eliot/ (e.g. 'Daily Notes/'), Eliot never consults that plugin config for this write (§A3 decoupling) and still resolves schedules_daily from vault_layout, landing the item in `Eliot/Schedules/Daily/<tomorrow>.md`. Confirms with the full Eliot/-prefixed path.

assertions.name: writes-inside-eliot-root
assertions.description: Target write path begins with Eliot/Schedules/Daily/, not a bare 'Daily Notes/' or an un-prefixed 'Schedules/Daily/'
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt shows path 'Eliot/Schedules/Daily/'; FAILS if the path shown is 'Daily Notes/' or bare 'Schedules/Daily/' without the 'Eliot/' prefix

assertions.name: no-plugin-eval-consulted
assertions.description: Does not call obsidian eval to read daily-notes plugin options for this write (plugin config is not authoritative — §A3)
assertions.check: trace.txt does not mention 'internalPlugins' or a daily-notes plugin config lookup for this capture

assertions.name: confirmation-shows-full-path
assertions.description: Confirmation names the full Eliot/-prefixed path (voice rule from examples/dialogues.md Notes on Voice)
assertions.check: response.txt contains 'Eliot/Schedules/Daily/' in the confirmation line

evals.name: fleeting-gate
evals.prompt: capture: I think mondays are the worst
evals.expected_output: Rule 4 substance gate FAILS (no reason/mechanism, no connection, < 25 words, no TIL/idea: marker) → routes to inbox: appends `- [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] I think mondays are the worst` to `Eliot/Inbox/Inbox.md` (folder created lazily with consent if missing). Confirmation offers promotion: "say 'make it a note' to promote". Does NOT create a file under Eliot/Notes/.

assertions.name: routed-to-inbox-not-notes
assertions.description: Target is Eliot/Inbox/Inbox.md, not a new file under Eliot/Notes/
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt shows a write to 'Eliot/Inbox/Inbox.md'; FAILS if a file under 'Eliot/Notes/' was created

assertions.name: offers-promotion
assertions.description: Confirmation offers promoting the parked item to a note
assertions.check: response.txt contains 'make it a note' or an equivalent promotion offer

assertions.name: no-empty-scaffold-note
assertions.description: No permanent note with empty '## Why It Matters'/'## Connections' scaffolding is created for the one-liner
assertions.check: trace.txt does not show creation of a note containing empty '## Connections' or '- Supports:' skeleton

evals.name: duplicate-project-guard
evals.prompt: eliot, start a project called psmux
evals.expected_output: Create Guard fires: probes `obsidian read path="Eliot/Projects/psmux.md"` BEFORE any create. File exists (fixture) → Eliot never calls `obsidian create` (which would auto-suffix `psmux 1.md`); asks once: "psmux already exists — update it, view it, or pick a different name?"

assertions.name: probes-before-create
assertions.description: An obsidian read of Eliot/Projects/psmux.md happens before any create call
assertions.check: trace.txt shows 'read' with 'Eliot/Projects/psmux.md' before any 'create' call

assertions.name: no-auto-suffix-duplicate
assertions.description: No 'psmux 1.md' (or any suffixed duplicate) is created
assertions.check: trace.txt does not contain 'psmux 1' and no obsidian create targeting Projects/ runs

assertions.name: asks-update-view-rename
assertions.description: Eliot asks whether to update, view, or pick a different name
assertions.check: response.txt contains 'already exists' and offers at least two of: update / view / different name

evals.name: missing-project-link
evals.prompt: capture: sippos: fixed the login redirect bug in the auth callback
evals.expected_output: User explicitly names project 'sippos' but no Eliot/Projects/sippos.md exists. Eliot searches Projects/, finds no match, and asks once: "No project `sippos` yet — create `Eliot/Projects/sippos.md` and link, or capture without a link?" NEVER silently writes a dangling [[sippos]] wikilink (§Dual-Link invariant: an unverified project reference never becomes a wikilink).

assertions.name: searches-projects-first
assertions.description: Searches/reads Projects/ for 'sippos' before any write
assertions.check: trace.txt shows an obsidian search or read scoped to Projects/ with 'sippos' before any create/append

assertions.name: offers-create-or-unlinked
assertions.description: Asks whether to create the project or capture without a link
assertions.check: response.txt contains an offer to create Eliot/Projects/sippos.md or capture without a link

assertions.name: no-silent-dangling-wikilink
assertions.description: Does not write [[sippos]] into any file before the user answers
assertions.check: trace.txt shows no write containing '[[sippos]]' before the user's choice

evals.name: profile-rewrite-only
evals.prompt: eliot, remember: I prefer 25-minute pomodoros for deep work
evals.expected_output: New Profile.md fact goes through the §7a whole-file rewrite — read Profile.md, insert the bullet under ## Preferences (## Vault Layout stays the final section), show ≤12-line diff preview, then `obsidian create ... overwrite` on confirmation. NEVER `obsidian append` to Profile.md (EOF-only append corrupts the schema).

assertions.name: no-append-to-profile
assertions.description: No obsidian append call targets Profile.md
assertions.check: trace.txt does not contain an 'append' call with 'Profile.md'

assertions.name: diff-preview-shown
assertions.description: A diff preview of the change is shown before the overwrite
assertions.check: response.txt contains a preview with '+' marked line(s) and asks to apply before any overwrite runs

assertions.name: fact-in-correct-section
assertions.description: The new bullet is inserted under ## Preferences, not after the ## Vault Layout block
assertions.check: the proposed content in trace.txt/response.txt places the pomodoro bullet inside ## Preferences and keeps ## Vault Layout as the final section

evals.name: task-done
evals.expected_output: §Lifecycle task-done flow: reads today's daily note (fixture has `- [ ] buy groceries`), finds exactly one match, shows the one-line diff, and flips the line to `- [x] buy groceries` via a daily-note rewrite (create ... overwrite, approval). Other lines untouched. Records op:"task-done" in last-write.

assertions.name: reads-daily-note-first
assertions.description: Reads the daily note before writing
assertions.check: trace.txt shows 'read' with 'Eliot/Schedules/Daily/' before any write

assertions.name: flips-checkbox
assertions.description: The task line becomes '- [x] buy groceries'
assertions.check: trace.txt or response.txt shows '- [x] buy groceries' in the written content

assertions.name: rest-of-note-preserved
assertions.description: Only the matched line changes; frontmatter and other lines are preserved verbatim
assertions.check: the rewritten content in trace.txt preserves all non-matched lines from the fixture

evals.name: archive-project
evals.expected_output: §Lifecycle project-archive flow: confirms, then three `obsidian property:set` calls on Eliot/Projects/psmux.md — status=done, tags=["project","status/done"], completed=<today>. No file move, no whole-file rewrite. Confirms the project drops out of daily reviews.

assertions.name: uses-property-set
assertions.description: Archive is done via obsidian property:set calls, not create/overwrite or a file move
assertions.check: trace.txt shows property:set with 'status' and 'done' targeting psmux.md; no renameFile/create overwrite for this flow

assertions.name: tags-flipped-to-done
assertions.description: tags become ["project","status/done"] (so the status/active daily-review search no longer matches)
assertions.check: trace.txt shows property:set with 'status/done' in the tags value

assertions.name: confirms-before-archiving
assertions.description: Asks for confirmation before the property writes
assertions.check: response.txt contains a confirmation question mentioning 'archive' before the property:set calls run

evals.name: daily-stub-minimal
evals.prompt: capture: call the plumber tomorrow at 10
evals.expected_output: Tomorrow's daily note doesn't exist → daily-note gate fires: creates the minimal stub (frontmatter date/type/tags + `# <YYYY-MM-DD>` H1 ONLY — no Morning Intentions/Evening Reflection sections, no blank checkboxes), then appends `- [ ] 10:00 Call the plumber`.

assertions.name: stub-created-before-append
assertions.description: A create for the missing daily note happens before the append
assertions.check: trace.txt shows obsidian create for 'Eliot/Schedules/Daily/<tomorrow>.md' before the append call

assertions.name: stub-is-minimal
assertions.description: Stub contains only frontmatter (date/type/tags) and the H1 date — no section headings, no blank '- [ ] ' stubs
assertions.check: the created stub content in trace.txt has frontmatter + '# ' H1 and does NOT contain 'Morning Intentions', 'Evening Reflection', or a blank '- [ ] ' line

assertions.name: never-bare-line-file
assertions.description: The daily note is never created as a bare checkbox line without frontmatter/H1
assertions.check: trace.txt does not show a created daily note whose full content is just a '- [ ]' line

evals.name: doctor-report
evals.expected_output: Read-only scan runs first: finds (fixture) the literal placeholder '[What does done look like?]' in a project file and a dangling `up: [[ghost]]` wikilink in a note. Reports both as numbered findings grouped by check, then asks 'Fix which? (all / #s / none)'. ZERO writes before the user picks.

assertions.name: finds-placeholder-residue
assertions.description: Report lists the '[What does done look like?]' placeholder finding
assertions.check: response.txt mentions the placeholder text or names the project file under a placeholder-residue finding

assertions.name: finds-broken-wikilink
assertions.description: Report lists the dangling [[ghost]] wikilink finding
assertions.check: response.txt mentions 'ghost' or the dangling-link file under a broken-wikilink finding

assertions.name: zero-writes-before-pick
assertions.description: No create/append/property:set/eval write runs before the user picks fixes
assertions.check: trace.txt shows only read/search calls before the 'Fix which?' question in response.txt

assertions.name: numbered-findings-with-pick-prompt
assertions.description: Findings are numbered and the report ends asking which to fix
assertions.check: response.txt contains a numbered list and a 'Fix which' (all / #s / none) style question
